Video.summary: Capt. Jonathan Moss is in Flamingo, Everglades National Park, in search of silver and gold.

Video.summary: Captain Jonathan Moss and Captain James Hillman are heading out of Highland Park Fish Camp in Deland, Florida, looking for largemouth bass.

Video.summary: Capt. Jonathan Moss is fishing in Pine Island Sound, Fl with Ty Nelson, Founder of Florida Fishing Products.

Video.summary: Capt. Blair has some down time in Alaska, so what does he do? Heads to the beach to check out the salmon hatchery in Ketchican. They've met their quota for the year so the season is open, but the trick is how to catch the salmon. There hasn't been an episode like this yet.
Video.title: "Salmon Snagging"

Video.summary: U.S. Marines combat correspondent Ken Plant tells of being captured and tortured as a POW.
Video.title: "Ken Plant"

Video.summary: 101 year old WWII U.S. Navy veteran George Hamilton recounts his amazing life in the service and as a post war semi-pro baseball player.
Video.title: "George Hamilton"

Video.summary: U.S. Air Force Lieutenant Colonel Todd Berge recounts his life as a fighter pilot and B2 Stealth Bomber pilot/instructor.
Video.title: "Todd Berge"

Video.summary: U.S. Navy veteran John Fleming recounts the life altering effects of his traumatic brain injury which cost him his rank.
Video.title: "John Fleming"

Video.summary: Retired Army Sergeant Andy Hendrickson recounts his deployment during Operation Iraqi Freedom One, at the aptly adopted named base, Mortar-Ritaville.
Video.title: "Andy Hendrickson"

Video.summary: Captain Mike Anderson and Captain Sebastian Velez get on a great Trout bite in their home waters.
Video.title: "Backyard Trout"

Video.summary: Mike tries heavy mat flippin’ for the first time. Fishing with pro bass angler Robbie Crosnoe.
Video.title: "New Territory"

Video.summary: In this episode of Reel Animals Mike is fishing in Louisiana for the infamous Bull Red!
Video.title: "Bronze Bomber"

Video.summary: Mike Heads over to Bartow to chase ditch pickles with his good friends from Bartow Ford.
Video.title: "Bartow Bass"

Video.summary: Mike Anderson is fishing in the Florida Keys for Tarpon" on this episode of Reel Animals that takes viewers on an unforgettable journey into the heart of the Florida Keys, renowned worldwide for its pristine waters and abundant marine life.
Video.title: "Key Largo"

Video.summary: From Miami to Apalachicola Bay, Florida, Capt. Jonathan Moss revisits some of his favorite moments from this season.
Video.title: "From Bow to Stern"

Video.summary: Captain Jonathan Moss is fishing the South Carolina low country with Captain Stephen Flook Jr. The weather is cold and windy, but the plan remains the same, FULL SEND!
Video.title: "Full Send"

Video.summary: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.
Video.title: Wildbound - "UK Part 2"

Video.summary: Hunter’s dollars play a vital role in the conservation efforts of wild sheep populations. Dan Cabela joins a team of researchers to capture and test a population of Bighorn Sheep for disease, as well as pursuing a ram of his own.
Video.title: "Sheep on the Mountain"

Video.summary: Dan Cabela travels to Mexico to pursue an elusive species of deer - along the way he learns about the threats to this ecosystem and how the remaining forest is being protected by the efforts of the local hunting concessions.
Video.title: "Tropical Deer of Mexico"

Video.summary: Black bear conservation requires different approaches across the United States - Dan Cabela explores the reality of what is being done to protect the species in Oklahoma, Arkansas and Maine.
Video.title: "Bear Necessities"

Video.summary: Dan Cabela joins a well-known outfitter in Spain to pursue an iconic species - the ibex. Along the way, he learns about the rich Spanish hunting tradition, the care with which the practice is managed and the conservation-minded ethos of the country.
Video.title: "Spanish Icons"

Video.summary: When the captain calls and says the weather in Alaska is great, you don't waste the opportunity. So Capt. Blair and the whole crew head out for a day of fishing. With one camera on the boat, things got a little chaotic with all the catching going on.
Video.title: "Weather Window Day"

Video.summary: After multiple days in Alaska, it was time for the last trip out to sea. The crew got to experience the sights on this trip, like God Valley and others. And of course catch more Alaskan fish.
Video.title: "The Final Voyage"

Video.summary: Down in Sebastion, the monster snook wait. These fish are so elusive, men have gotten divorced chasing these things. These can be once in a lifetime fish, and even then it's not a guarantee.
Video.title: "Hunting a Mogan"

Video.summary: PCB’s white sand beaches are jam-packed with visitors soaking up sun - and surf while Justin and Meredith chase schools of migrating tarpon - just offshore. How often do those two worlds collide?
Video.title: "Tarpon Town"

Video.summary: While releasing a defeated tarpon healthy after an epic battle is the ultimate victory, everything else is measured in heartbreak and degrees of failure. For Justin, putting Ethan on his first silver king requires patience and a tasty diversion by a local chef.
Video.title: "Silver King Thing"

Video.summary: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Saltwater Experience Charters’ Captain Garrett Stephens for a trip into the Gulf. When their catches get repeatedly cut off, they decide to bring the massive bull sharks up to the surface for a closer look.
Video.title: "Gulf Monsters With Captain Garrett Stephens"

Video.summary: After wrestling with some massive bull sharks, Captains Tom Rowland, Rich Tudor and guest Captain Garrett Stephens encounter some crazy cobia action and it takes all their strength and skill to keep them away from the sharks.
Video.title: "Cobia Fishing With Garrett Stephens"

Video.summary: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor utilize the Yellowfin Hybrid 26’ to bring the Live Paddle Boards out to an Islamorada flat for a fun day of fishing for bonefish and some toothy critters.
Video.title: "Islamorada Paddleboard Fishing"

Video.summary: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor run west from Hawks Cay to fish the spring tarpon migration at the legendary Bahia Honda bridge.
Video.title: "Bahia Honda Tarpon"

Video.summary: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head down to Key West to join Captain Brandon Cyr for some skinny water bonefishing.
Video.title: "Bonefishing Key West with Captain Brandon Cyr"

Video.summary: Captains Scott and Steve take a long run into the Gulf from Stock Island and load the coolers with Cobia and huge Yellowtail Snapper.

Video.summary: The final day of the Baitfuel Fishing Tour Championship starts at Joel Stone Heritage Park in Gananoque, Ontario where a winner will be crowned and one luck team will be walking away with a Bass Cat / Mercury Package.
Video.title: BaitFuel Fishing Tour - "Tour Championship Day 2"

Video.summary: JP heads to Argentina and Don Joaquin River Lodge in search of the elusive Golden Dorado.
Video.title: "Argentina Golden Dorado"

Video.summary: Today, Capt. Danny is joined by his son Dillan for a plug-filled day in their local waters of Cedar Key, FL!
Video.title: "Pluggin' The Roots"

Video.summary: The word is out! The Southern California Bluefin Tuna fishing is on fire and the waters of San Diego are literally Foaming with Life. Ali and Rush switch their targets from the jumbo size Bluefin Tuna to a smaller, medium grade fish for non-stop run and gun action. But, with so many fish fixated on the masses of bait in the area, it may take a million casts to pull one out of the froth.
Video.title: "Socal Foam"

Video.summary: Possibly more rewarding then an invite to experience a new fishery is one's ability to return the favor. For Ali and Rush, sharing their home waters with others is one of the best parts of the job. While Rush takes SoCal friends Brandon and Eric Nelson fishing in Key West for Permit, Ali rounds up a familiar Florida Everglades native for some San Diego Bluefin Tuna fishing.
Video.title: "Invite Extended"

Video.summary: In the first installment of this two part series, the guys are bringing it back to where it all began for Local Knowledge. Ali and Rush head to Baja California Sur to meet up with Julio Meza and friends in the towns of La Bocana and Abreojos to target large Gulf and Broomtail grouper in shallow water. This time around the crew trades the stressful drive with boat in tow for a quick flight right into grouper country.
Video.title: "Return To Baja Pt. 1"

Video.summary: The Baja Reunion continues as Ali and Rush fish for large shallow water groupers with good friend Julio Meza in the towns of Abreojos and La Bocana. Exploring what makes for such a strong fishery, the guys check out the nearby estuaries that serve as the birthplace for many of these grouper before heading out for a "big one."
Video.title: "Return To Baja Pt. 2"

Video.summary: Season 10 is a wrap! Rush takes a moment to look back on some of his favorite moments from battling giant snook and feisty tarpon in Florida, to overnighting at Catalina Island, and chasing bull redfish in Louisiana. This season was all about getting out there with good friends, making new ones, and enjoying the sport we love. An unforgettable year filled with adventure, laughs, and epic days on the water.
Video.title: "Season 10 Wrap Up!"

Video.summary: For DIRT’s first trip across the pond, host Josh Rosen dove head first into Ireland. From long-held traditions to the modern-day artisanal movement, he unearthed the multicultural goldmine between the highlands and the Wild Atlantic Way—with stops for surfing, a seaweed bath, and a couple holes of golf spectated by free-range goats, of course. Foraged cocktails? Fresh crabs from Galway Bay? It’s all on the table in this episode rooted in community, homegrown ingredients, and the damn good people who bring it all together. Subscribe to our YouTube channel to catch up on all of DIRT’s past adventures.
Video.title: DIRT - "The ULTIMATE Ireland Food Road Trip | Surfing, Golfing & Delicious Eats"

Video.summary: Hop in the float plane—a new episode of DIRT just dropped. The DIRT crew made their way to Alaska, “the land of earth, sea, and sky.” All feast, no sleep is the name of the game as Josh makes the most of Alaska’s abundant and legendary daylight alongside local guides, fishermen, and even a couple grizzlies. There’ll be plenty of time to hibernate in winter. But for now—join us—there are halibut to filet, rainforest ’shrooms to forage, and mountainside meals to cook up.
Video.title: DIRT - "Alaskan Fishing, Foraging, & Mountainside Cooking with Local Legends"

Image.alt: DIRT - "Alaskan Fishing, Foraging, & Mountainside Cooking with Local Legends"

Video.summary: Maine draws people in. Which the DIRT crew found out firsthand, meeting generations of craftspeople, skippers, and artists who embody the region’s past and present alike. After whetting their appetites in Portland with Chef Christian Hayes, Josh and the gang took off up the coast. Local goldenrod honey, a quick boat building lesson, and plenty of lobsters (of course) are just a sample of the bounty they picked up along the way. And the final feast is as Maine as it gets—you’ll see.
Video.title: DIRT - "Is Maine the Culinary Capital of New England Food?"

Video.summary: Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson travels to Cody Yellowstone, a gateway to the American West. While the region is best known for its proximity to Yellowstone National Park, Jonathan sets out to discover what lies beyond the typical tourist trail—uncovering the unexpected adventures, outdoor experiences, and local character that makes Cody Yellowstone a true adventure destination.
Video.title: "Cody, Wyoming"
